goals: Verify that the /auth/login endpoint returns an HTTP 200 status code for a valid login request.
activities: Define the target URL for the login request.
Prepare the JSON payload for the login request with username and password.
Set the request headers, specifying Content-Type as application/json.
Send an HTTP POST request to the login URL with the prepared payload and headers.
Log the body of the HTTP response to the console.
Verify that the HTTP response status code is 200.
